chronology.notes: An approximation of Cwynars' (1982) chron, equation of the line is Y= 1870 + 133.557x - 0.809229x2 - 0.00191696x3. The Chron uses 21 corrected C14 dates. Cwynars' chronology has an equation of the line of Y = -393.1 + 161.3x - 0.91168x2 + 0.00194x3.
Chron uses top and 21 corrected C14 dates. Equation of the line is Y = 150.007x - 0.835912x2 + 0.00180582x3.

site.sitedescription: Small lake in broad basin. Physiography: undulating tundra surface. Surrounding vegetation: tussock tundra/wet sedge/heath/fellfield.
